title: Teurer Paywall-Spaß
body: Für das was es tut, kostet es immer noch zu viel. Ein paar Euro im Monat zu viel, die ich dann doch lieber einmalig in Goblin Tools investiert habe. Da habe ich im Kern die selbe Funktionalität, nur eben nicht so hübsch verpackt.
author: himalayaLux

title: Deceptive Paywall Ruins Experience
body: The app seems promising at first, but leading users through setup and investment of time only to hit an unexpected, hefty paywall is unacceptable. Paywalls belong in the App Store in the form of a price tag, not hidden in the user experience. This is bad usability and feels deceptive.
author: Alchemist.Stef

title: I have adhd
body:
And this really helps me get things done! Wow :)

author: Dr.schokolade

title: Missing some features
body:
First of all, I downloaded it today and just set up my main tasks. This is the first time I wasn’t angry about having to pay, since the price is very cheap. So that’s a great thing.
Overall I do like the app, and I’ve got the feeling that it’ll help me.
But I am missing a few features.
The first thing is, that it would be better if you could set a specific reminder time for each task, and on what days you want to be reminded.
The second thing would be alarm sounds you could choose for the tasks.
If it had those features, I’d call this a perfect app
author: cfdgdfvzm

title: Perfect tool for adhd
body: I recommend this app to everyone who struggles with executive dysfunction. It makes big task so easy to pursue and also with the visual timer it feel quite rewarding to see how far a task is done.
author: Joaltajb

title: Helped with my ADHD
body: Honestly this app changed my life. The automatic sub task creation helps to break down small tasks and make them manageable
